verdict.rationale: Bugbot findings carry first-party "Fix in Cursor" links that open issues directly in the Cursor IDE, and "Fix in Web" links that open them in cursor.com/agents. That is a direct hand-off to a coding agent, which the story accepts as one of its alternatives. The documentation is a one-line mention without detail on what context is passed, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: copyable fix prompts or hand-off to Claude Code or Codex, documentation of what context the hand-off carries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Fix-in-Cursor flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, review findings hand off cleanly to my coding agent — copyable fix prompts or direct integration with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex

citations.quote: Fix in Cursor links open issues directly in Cursor
